AcceptanceCriteria: Player starts on the survey platform facing +X toward the hidden exit tunnel.
Notes: Use the Blueprint player start expected by the current game mode.

AcceptanceCriteria: A 10-14 m temporary human platform anchors the opening and makes the player scale readable.
Notes: Blockout platform is acceptable until the human survey kit exists.

AcceptanceCriteria: Black basalt walls surround the elevator and hide the main rift view until Zone 2.
Notes: Use dark rock modules or primitives with rough vertical silhouettes.

ApproxLocation: Near elevator platform and access tunnel
AcceptanceCriteria: 4-6 temporary props are visible: crates, cable coils, portable lamps, or rail sections.
Notes: Keep props recent and practical, not ancient.

AcceptanceCriteria: Discovery actor scans from the player path and records the human survey elevator entry.
Notes: Set ScanFocusOffset to approximately 0,0,80.

AcceptanceCriteria: Small white/amber lamps illuminate the human staging area without competing with the rift glow.
Notes: Target radius 400-600 cm per lamp.

AcceptanceCriteria: Trigger completes the first objective as the player exits the start tunnel.
Notes: Suggested box 600x400x300 cm.

AcceptanceCriteria: The ledge provides an 8-12 m playable overlook and visually reads as a 25-40 m shelf.
Notes: Must support the first concept-art composition.

ApproxLocation: Above and left of overlook view
AcceptanceCriteria: Dark rock frames the top and left side of the vista without blocking the orb, collector array, or gate.
Notes: Use SM_Rift_RockArch_A / SM_Rift_Overhang_A when available.

AcceptanceCriteria: 3-5 small or medium crystal clusters create cyan foreground accents and route language.
Notes: Do not over-light the vista; the orb remains the focal point.

AcceptanceCriteria: A beacon, lamp, tripod, or crate makes the ledge scale readable in screenshots.
Notes: Keep it small enough not to steal focus.

AcceptanceCriteria: A blue-white orb proxy with 18-28 m diameter is visible from the first overlook.
Notes: Orb should retain detail and not bloom into a flat disc.

AcceptanceCriteria: Hex collector clusters read as flower-like panels around the central orb.
Notes: Broken or tilted panels should break sterile symmetry.

AcceptanceCriteria: Right-side gate wall is visible across the void and reads 80-140 m tall.
Notes: Circular blue-lit mechanisms must be visible from overlook distance.

AcceptanceCriteria: Blue atmospheric depth suggests a 300 m or deeper fall beneath the route.
Notes: Use fog and distant silhouettes rather than flat floor planes.

AcceptanceCriteria: Trigger advances once the player reaches the beauty-shot ledge.
Notes: Suggested box 900x1200x400 cm.

AcceptanceCriteria: 3-5 ledges form a descending route from natural rock into ancient structures.
Notes: Keep route width mostly 6-10 m and readable without excessive railings.

AcceptanceCriteria: At least one intact ancient bridge span links ledges across the abyss.
Notes: Walkable collision must be simple and reliable.

AcceptanceCriteria: At least one broken span creates a damaged ancient-machine silhouette without blocking the route.
Notes: Missing chunks should be decorative unless traversal is explicitly tested.

AcceptanceCriteria: The central orb is visible at least twice through rock or machine openings during the descent.
Notes: Use sightline checks from player height.

AcceptanceCriteria: Medium blue crystals guide the player toward the Collector Array.
Notes: Avoid uniform spacing; clusters should feel grown into rock seams.

AcceptanceCriteria: Discovery actor can scan a clear blue crystal cluster from the route.
Notes: Set ScanFocusOffset to approximately 0,0,140.

AcceptanceCriteria: Trigger advances after the player reaches the end of the descent sequence.
Notes: Suggested box 1000x1000x500 cm.

AcceptanceCriteria: One side reads as carved ancient wall panels while the other remains basalt cave.
Notes: Crystals should visibly pierce both natural and machine surfaces.

AcceptanceCriteria: 8-12 mixed-size clusters fill the gallery, including one 7-9 m large cluster.
Notes: This is the strongest close-up crystal zone in the first slice.

AcceptanceCriteria: A rock arch or window frames the orb in the distance from the player path.
Notes: This should become a secondary screenshot target.

AcceptanceCriteria: A circular blue-lit inset platform introduces the Collector Array machine language up close.
Notes: Use SM_Rift_PlatformNode_A when available.

AcceptanceCriteria: Discovery actor scans a resonant crystal formation from a clear player-accessible spot.
Notes: Set ScanFocusOffset to approximately 0,0,120.

AcceptanceCriteria: Trigger advances as the player exits the crystal gallery toward the orb apparatus.
Notes: Suggested box 900x900x500 cm.

AcceptanceCriteria: Orb actor/proxy sits at the visual center with 18-28 m diameter and controlled bloom.
Notes: Blueprint may start from a mesh sphere plus emissive material and lights.

AcceptanceCriteria: Partial ring/frame makes the orb read as contained by ancient machinery.
Notes: Frame should not hide the orb from the First Overlook.

AcceptanceCriteria: 5-8 collector clusters surround the orb and create the concept-art flower pattern.
Notes: Include at least one damaged or tilted cluster.

AcceptanceCriteria: Gold beams visibly connect hub/emitter nodes to collector cluster centers through fog.
Notes: Beam color stays gold/amber, not lava orange.

AcceptanceCriteria: Player reaches a platform near the apparatus without intersecting the energy volume.
Notes: Surface supports at least two beacon placement spots.

AcceptanceCriteria: 3-5 beam emitter nodes anchor gold spline endpoints and read at player scale.
Notes: Warm endpoint glow should be localized.

AcceptanceCriteria: Discovery actor scans the orb apparatus from the safe platform.
Notes: Set ScanFocusOffset high enough to target the orb center, approximately 0,0,300.

AcceptanceCriteria: Trigger advances when the player reaches the safe platform near the apparatus.
Notes: Suggested box 1200x1200x600 cm.

AcceptanceCriteria: Monumental gate dominates the zone and reads as 80-140 m tall from player height.
Notes: This must match the reference image's right-side massing.

AcceptanceCriteria: At least one large circular blue core is visible from the player route.
Notes: Cores are secondary focal points, below the central orb in hierarchy.

AcceptanceCriteria: A 6-8 m wide bridge or platform carries the player across/in front of the gate safely.
Notes: Gold beam spill should graze the wall surface.

AcceptanceCriteria: Discovery actor scans the monumental gate from a clear route position.
Notes: Set ScanFocusOffset to approximately 0,0,400.

AcceptanceCriteria: Trigger advances after the player commits to the gate crossing.
Notes: Suggested box 1000x1200x600 cm.

AcceptanceCriteria: Final ledge frames the lower rift and supports a stable end-beat view.
Notes: Can reuse SM_Rift_ForegroundLedge_A or a bridge-edge variant.

AcceptanceCriteria: Lower rift opens into a larger blue-lit void with no visible flat floor.
Notes: Use distant spires, hanging slabs, and fog layers.

AcceptanceCriteria: Tiny human station props can sit behind the player without entering the main vista.
Notes: Only add after the primary composition is working.

AcceptanceCriteria: Scanning the final vista completes OBJ_SecondSkyOverlook through ObjectiveIdToCompleteOnScan.
Notes: Set bCompleteObjectiveOnlyOnNewDiscovery=true.

AcceptanceCriteria: Fallback trigger exists only for early testing if scan completion is not wired yet.
Notes: Prefer scan completion for the final route beat.

AcceptanceCriteria: Prototype blockers prevent accidental falls until falling/respawn is implemented.
Notes: Hide blockers with low rock lips, curbs, or rubble.

ApproxLocation: Collector Array and visible from route
AcceptanceCriteria: Orb provides the dominant cool light source throughout the cavern.
Notes: Use hidden point/rect lights plus emissive; keep exposure controlled.

AcceptanceCriteria: Distant towers, slabs, and spires fade into blue atmospheric perspective.
Notes: First Overlook and Second Sky screenshots must show strong vertical depth.

ApproxLocation: First Overlook, Approach, Galleries, Collector Array
AcceptanceCriteria: At least four obvious flat beacon surfaces exist along the route.
Notes: Surfaces should be useful for navigation, not just decorative.
